strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_ExportNameHelp: Renames the exported files (model, .bin, and every texture) instead of using the asset's raw internal name. Leave blank to use the default name shown above.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_NoInstancesFound: No instances of this asset are placed in the loaded level.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_NotInRegionTooltip: Classes the level ships that the loaded region does not place. They are read from the level's files when picked.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_SelectedMeshHint: Click a bangle/mesh in the preview above to inspect it.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_SelectedMeshStale: This bangle/mesh no longer exists on the current selection.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_VertexEditModeHelp: Shows a dot at every vertex of the selected mesh (inverted against whatever's behind it, so it stays visible on any texture) and lets you click one to inspect it below. The larger dot is the one currently shown in the raw data panel.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_RawVertexUnavailab: Not available for this mesh's source format.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_UFragNoPreview: No scene entity for this UFrag, so there is nothing to preview - the data and export below still work.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_UFragNoLightmapUVs: No lightmap UVs (UVs2) on this UFrag.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_UFragUVOutOfRange: UV2 falls outside [0,1] - atlas addressing is wrong, not the bake.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_UFragNoMetadata: Raw record not retained for this UFrag.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_UFragBakedScaleHel: Stands in for the game's per-draw lightScale constant (vc[2].z), which is unsourced. The atlases are dark as stored (non-black texels average ~0.13), so this is what brings them up to game brightness. Applies to this preview only, not the 3D View.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_UFragDebugViewHelp: Renders the lightmap texel with no albedo or shading. Baked surfaces show their bake; everything else goes flat grey. Tells you whether a black surface is a black bake or shading killing it.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_UFragNeedsLighting: Turn on lighting (the bulb in the viewport toolbar) to see the bake on the model.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_UFragExportNote: Exported asset-local, positions descaled by 256 - the placement anchor is NOT applied, matching Moby/Tie export.
strings.GUI_Frame_EditorSettings_BackfaceCulling: Culls back-facing triangles. Triangle winding in these source assets isn't reliably consistent (sometimes not even within a single mesh; see SelectionOutlineRenderer's notes), so this can show holes in some meshes. Off by default; toggle live to see how bad it actually is on real data.
strings.GUI_Frame_EditorSettings_CodeEditorTheme: Colours for the Lua editor, from Themes/<name>.json next to the executable. Lexical roles (keyword, string, number, comment) come from the lexer; Function, Method, Class, Field, Local and Parameter are resolved from scope analysis and the documented API. Edit a file or add your own and it appears here, or pick colours live in the Lua environment's Theme tab.
strings.GUI_Frame_ShaderBrowser_ParallaxNeedsLig: Only visible with lighting on (the bulb in the 3D viewport's toolbar).
strings.GUI_Frame_EditorSettings_VolumeWireThick: How thick a volume's wireframe box edges are, in absolute world units. This is also the clickable region in the 3D view
strings.GUI_Frame_EditorSettings_CameraPovFovHel: Horizontal field of view used when looking through a camera whose settings give none. The game's own default is not known yet.
strings.GUI_Frame_EditorSettings_RestartRequired: Takes effect on the next restart; changing this doesn't recreate the graphics device/render targets while the app is running.
strings.GUI_Frame_EditorSettings_UpdateChannelHe: Stable checks the latest tagged GitHub release. Nightly checks the rolling nightly build published on every push to the nightly branch; unstable, dev-facing, updated far more often.
strings.GUI_Frame_EditorSettings_IncludePrerelea: Offer alphas, betas and release candidates as updates. Off by default: these are published for testing and may be unstable. The final release always supersedes a prerelease of the same version.
This build is itself a prerelease, so prereleases are always considered - otherwise no update could ever be offered, since this version is newer than every stable release.
strings.GUI_Frame_EntityExplorer_KindToggle: {0}: show or hide in the hierarchy. Ctrl+click: only these, or everything again.
strings.GUI_Frame_EntityExplorer_GroupingHelp: How a layer's content is grouped: Mobys and Ties by their asset (or the asset's folder, then the asset), volumes by Clue class, cameras by class.
strings.GUI_Frame_EntityExplorer_EyeHelp: Show or hide in the 3D view (on a selected row: the whole selection). Right-click a row for more.
strings.GUI_Frame_EntityExplorer_AddContents: Add everything in it to the selection
strings.GUI_Frame_EntityExplorer_Isolate: Isolate (hide the rest of the tree)
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_Animation_Un: This animation cannot be played back yet.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_NameChangeNo: The entity name cannot be changed.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_PathHint: The gizmo moves, turns or scales the whole path. Click one of its keys in the viewport to move it, then its handles to shape the curve. Edits are in memory only for now.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_PathSpline: A cubic spline with {0} keys, exported as {1} points per span: edited through its keys and their handles, and sampled again the same way.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_PathPolyline: A polyline: its points are not a spline's samples, so each one is a key of its own.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_PathHandle: A handle of key {0} of {1} of {2}
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_PathHandlesH: Smooth: the two handles stay opposite and the same length. Aligned: opposite, each its own length. Free: independent, a corner.
strings.GUI_PathPanel_AddHint: Adds a key between this one and its neighbour without changing the curve, or, past either end, one span further along the path's direction.
strings.GUI_PathPanel_ConvertToSplineHint: Makes every point a key with smooth Bezier handles, each segment a curve sampled 10 times, as the game's spline paths are.
strings.GUI_PathPanel_Hint: Drag a key, handle or point to move it in the horizontal plane; hold Shift when grabbing it to move it up and down. The gizmo moves it along an axis. Delete removes the selected key.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_PathInsertKe: Splits the span after this key in two at its middle, without changing its shape. The path gains 10 points.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_PathRemoveKe: Merges the two spans either side into the one curve that follows them best. The path loses 10 points.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_MultipleSele: Below: the active one (the last clicked). The gizmo moves the whole selection about it.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_PathRoleName: {0} (guessed from its name: nothing in the level's data uses it)
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_PathRoleNone: No role: nothing in the level's data uses it and its name says nothing (likely a script's)
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_VolumeRole: Role: {0} (a plain volume; its Clue is below)
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_SelectWithRe: Selects this Clue's volume and every instance its settings name (a moon: its gravity volume and landing pad beam), so the gizmo moves them together. Changes stay in the editor until the gameplay file can be written.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_SettingsHint: Editable; File > Save Level writes them. Right-click an offset for more.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_SettingsCopy: Copy this word to every instance of this class
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_CameraFovDef: FOV {0}° (horizontal; the editor's default, the game's is unknown)
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_CameraNote: Shown at its placement, looking along its local +Z (a CamArgFixed camera is exactly there). Most CamArgBlendable cameras share one placement rotation, so their real view direction is in their settings, not decoded yet.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_NavmeshLinks: {0} of {1} edges link to another chunk
strings.GUI_Frame_LevelExportModal_NothingSelect: Select at least one category to export.
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_ScriptsNoLevel: Load a level to list its scripts.
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_ScriptsNotFound: Could not find {0} next to the loaded level.
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_SnippetStops: expanded '{0}' - Tab for the next of {1} stop(s), Esc to leave
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_SnippetAt: snippet stop {0} of {1} - Tab for next, Esc to leave
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_SplitHint: show the source and its disassembly side by side
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_InstallHelp: Compiles the script and writes both it and its bytecode back into the level's archive. A copy of the archive is kept before every save, with the date and time in its name (.bak). Nothing is written unless the script compiles and the rebuilt archive verifies.
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_ScriptsBusy: An archive write is already running - wait for it to finish.
strings.GUI_LoadingFrame_HideTooltip: Hides this window. The work carries on, and the status bar keeps its progress.
strings.GUI_StatusBar_Tooltip: {0} task(s) running - click to see them all
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_FindHint: Enter steps forward, Shift+Enter back, Escape closes
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_NewScriptTooltip: Creates /levels/{0}/scripts/{1}.lua and lists it in the game's file index
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_NewScriptBadName: '{0}' cannot be a script name - the loaders take a bare name
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_DeclDocumented: '{0}' is documented in {1}, which is not a script in this archive
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_ThemeDefaultsApplied: Built-in defaults applied - not saved yet.
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_ThemeReverted: Reverted to the last saved colours.
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_ThemePreviewHint: Live preview - type in it, select text, move the caret. Semantic colours need the loaded game's docs.
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_Hint: Type if/while/for/function then space to expand, Tab between stops. Ctrl+Space completes, F2 renames, Ctrl+A/C/X/V/Z/Y
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_RenameUnresolved: '{0}' is not a resolvable name here
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_RenameGlobal: '{0}' is a global ({1} use(s) here) - other scripts and the engine reference it, so it is not renamed from this file
strings.GUI_LuaEnv_DisNotB4404: not the b4404 shape these games ship
strings.GUI_Frame_Profiler_GpuNote: "GPU Wait" is the per-frame WaitForIdle stall - the CPU blocked on the GPU. It stands in for GPU cost since NeoVeldrid exposes no GPU timestamp query.
strings.GUI_Frame_TextureExplorer_Preview_NoUsag: Not used by any loaded asset.
strings.GUI_Frame_TextureExplorer_Preview_NoRela: Not referenced by any parsed shader.
strings.GUI_Frame_UpdateInfo_StableAvailable: A new update for ReLunacy is available!
strings.GUI_Frame_UpdateInfo_NightlyAvailable: A newer nightly build of ReLunacy is available!
strings.GUI_SaveLevel_OldEngine: Saving is only written for the new engine (A Crack in Time, All 4 One, Into the Nexus) so far.
strings.GUI_SaveLevel_NothingChanged: Nothing to save: the gameplay files already hold what the editor shows.
strings.GUI_SaveLevel_Changes: {0} change(s) to write into the level's gameplay (gp_prius.dat):
strings.GUI_SaveLevel_Hint: Placements of Mobys, volumes, cameras and path points, and Clue / camera settings. Ties, new or deleted instances and paths with added or removed points are not saved yet. A copy of the archive is kept before every save, with the date and time in its name (.bak).
strings.GUI_SaveLevel_Saving: Saving: rebuilding the archive and checking every file in it...
strings.GUI_SaveLevel_Backup: The archive as it was before this save is kept at {0}
strings.GUI_Frame_LevelData_NoLightEnv: This level ships no analytic lighting environment (section 0x8b00).
strings.GUI_Viewport_Lit: Lit: shaded with the level's lights, normal maps, emissives and baked lighting. Click for unlit (flat albedo).
strings.GUI_Viewport_Unlit: Unlit: flat albedo, no lighting. Click to light the scene.
strings.GUI_Viewport_RsxShaders: RSX shaders: draw materials with the game's own fragment shaders (from a decrypted EBOOT in the level's install, and the shaders a material ships). Click to use the generic shading instead.
strings.GUI_Viewport_RsxShadersNeedLit: RSX shaders: only available while lit.
strings.GUI_Viewport_UFrags: UFrags: show the level's terrain fragments.
strings.GUI_Viewport_Volumes: Volumes: show the level's volume wireframes.
strings.GUI_Viewport_Cameras: Cameras: show the level's camera placements (its camera controllers) with a camera model.
strings.GUI_Viewport_PovLabel: {0}  ·  FOV {1}°  ·  Esc: back  ·  Right-drag: fly from here
strings.GUI_Viewport_PovLabelDefault: {0}  ·  FOV {1}° (default)  ·  Esc: back  ·  Right-drag: fly from here
strings.GUI_Viewport_PathFilters: Path colours and roles: colour the paths by what uses them (grind rail, ledge grab, camera, patrol...) or by layer, and show only some roles.
strings.GUI_Viewport_Paths: Paths: show the level's paths (grind and ledge rails, patrols, camera paths). Click one to select it and show its points; click a point to move it.
strings.GUI_Viewport_VolumeFilters: Volume filters: which volumes are drawn (by kind, layer, Area or Scent) and what their colour says.
strings.GUI_Paths_UnassignedHint: Paths nothing in the level's data uses and whose name says nothing: the level scripts use most of them.
strings.GUI_Paths_RoleLinked: Used by what the level's data links them to, e.g. {0}.
strings.GUI_Paths_RoleNamed: {0} linked by a Clue or controller, {1} guessed from their name.
strings.GUI_Volumes_FillHint: Which volumes are also drawn with translucent faces in their colour, under their wireframe.
strings.GUI_Volumes_PlainHint: Volumes that are no Clue's shape: triggers, cameras, targets and the like, named by the designers.
strings.GUI_Volumes_ClueHint: Clue class {0}: volumes that give the game a behaviour where they are.
strings.GUI_Volumes_RoleHint: Plain volumes a Clue names in a field whose meaning is known (a moon's gravity volume). Drawn with faces whenever faces are on.
strings.GUI_Volumes_GroupsHint: An Area groups paths and volumes, a Scent groups Clues.
strings.GUI_Viewport_BoundingSpheres: Bounding spheres: show each object's bounding sphere.
strings.GUI_Viewport_Navmesh: Navmesh: show the level's AI navigation mesh.
strings.GUI_Viewport_Collision: Collision: show the level's static collision, filter it, colour it, and edit it. Opens a panel; press again to close it.
strings.GUI_Collision_EditModeHint: Clicks in the viewport select collision instead of entities. The selection can then be edited below.
strings.GUI_Collision_ThroughWallsHint: Box selection takes every face whose centre is inside the box, including faces hidden behind other collision.
strings.GUI_Collision_SelectHint: Click: select. Shift: add. Ctrl: remove. Drag: box select. Esc: clear.
strings.GUI_Collision_SelectedFaces: {0} faces selected, in {1} shapes placed {2} times. An edit changes every placement.
strings.GUI_Collision_FlagBit0: Bit 0: Ratchet cannot wall jump off the face (ToD's wall-jump entry rejects it). Set on {0} of {1}.
strings.GUI_Collision_FlagBitUnknown: Meaning not decoded yet. Set on {0} of {1}.
strings.GUI_Collision_InstanceFlagBit: 0x{0:X}: meaning not decoded. Set on {1} of {2}.
strings.GUI_Collision_InstanceFlagPrimitive: 0x{0:X}: the shape is a primitive set. Describes the data, so it cannot be changed. Set on {1} of {2}.
strings.GUI_Label_CollisionMaterialNote: What each material means in game is not decoded yet.
strings.GUI_Label_CollisionTriangleFlagsNote: No bit set: a default walkable surface. Bit 0: Ratchet cannot wall jump off the face. Bits 1-4 are not decoded.
strings.GUI_Label_CollisionInstanceFlagsNote: 0x400: primitive set (new engine). Other bits not decoded.
strings.GUI_MenuItem_SkySeveralHint: Several ticked: the first one's dome and clouds, every one's shells.
strings.GUI_Frame_AssetViewer_NoFoliage: This level has no foliage (old engine only).
strings.GUI_Frame_GpuMemory_ReducedTitle: Textures reduced to fit video memory
strings.GUI_Frame_GpuMemory_Reduced:
This level's textures need {0} MiB at full resolution, but about {1} MiB of video memory is available for them. To keep the level from running the GPU out of memory, {2} of its {3} textures were reduced to at most {4} px ({5} MiB in all).

The level is complete; it is only less sharp. Closing other applications that use the GPU frees more memory for the next load.
strings.GUI_Frame_GpuMemory_Failed:
The GPU ran out of memory while loading this level's textures. The textures that did not fit are drawn with a plain placeholder.

{0}
strings.GUI_Frame_GpuMemory_BudgetFromDriver: {0}: {1} MiB of video memory, {2} MiB available to ReLunacy according to the driver.
strings.GUI_Frame_GpuMemory_BudgetFromHeap: {0}: {1} MiB of video memory (the driver does not report how much is free; {2} MiB assumed).
strings.GUI_Tuid_Tooltip: {0} - click to open, right-click for more
strings.GUI_MenuItem_MaxBakedScaleHint: Caps the per-placement scale instead of discarding it. Keeps the variation between placements, cuts the tail that cannot be right. 98% of QForce ties are under 8; A4O reaches 184.
strings.GUI_MenuItem_RetailBakedScaleHint: Off falls back to the fixed 3.0 the editor used before. The per-placement scale (Tie +0x64) is proven for QForce and matches retail there, but All 4 One measures p90 23 and max 184 where QForce has 5.5 and 48 - its record almost certainly lays those fields out differently.
strings.GUI_MenuItem_LightModeHint: Lighting is where a tie and a moby meet: a tie takes it from the lightmaps, a moby from its prelight, and both multiply it into the albedo. Start with Lighting only.
strings.GUI_MenuItem_CubeBiasHint: Added to each material's own +0x68 bias before the cube intensity is clamped. 0 leaves the authored values alone.
strings.GUI_MenuItem_TonemapPreviewHint: Rolls the lit colour off instead of clamping it. The scene is genuinely HDR, and clamping loses hue as well as brightness - the channels reach 1.0 at different points, so an over-bright surface changes colour instead of going white.
strings.GUI_Frame_CubemapViewer_FaceResource: resource TUID {0:X16}, cube {1} of 4  (this is what instances reference)
strings.GUI_Frame_CubemapViewer_FaceKey: cube key {0:X16}  (the 0x5A00 key, NOT the resource TUID)
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_CubemapNoTui: This instance declares no cube TUID, so it uses resource 0 of the active region.
strings.GUI_Frame_InstanceInspector_CubemapFallb: NOT in the active region's cubemap set - falling back to resource 0. This instance belongs to a region whose environment is not the one currently shown.
strings.GUI_Frame_CubemapViewer_None: This level has no new-engine HDR cubemaps. The old engine's cube is shown in the Texture Explorer instead.
strings.GUI_Frame_CubemapViewer_ReconLinear: rgb x max(a + bias, 0)   (what the shaders do)
strings.GUI_Frame_CubemapViewer_ReconExp2: rgb x exp2((a x 255 + k1) / k2)
strings.GUI_Frame_CubemapViewer_OrientationNote: All 48 orientations join at the seams equally well; only a known direction in the level can tell them apart.
strings.GUI_Frame_CubemapViewer_SweepSync: Apply each candidate to the 3D view
strings.GUI_Frame_CubemapViewer_SweepSyncCost: Each step rebuilds the scene capture; expect a hitch per candidate.
strings.GUI_Frame_MissingEboot_Message: Warning! The game you just scanned is missing the EBOOT.elf! Please decrypt it using RPCS3 (or similar) to use the game's shaders.
